title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join INTRALOT as a DevOps Engineer!

Empower Innovation. Drive Impact. Shape the Future.
Are you a passionate DevOps professional ready to take the next step in your career? At INTRALOT, we're not just building infrastructure - we're transforming the gaming industry with scalable, reliable, and cutting-edge systems.
Here's your chance to make a difference and grow with a dynamic team that thrives on innovation and collaboration.

What You'll Do
As a DevOps Engineer, you'll play a vital role in enhancing operations and contributing to the delivery of high-quality software. Your contributions will make a difference as you:
 Support Scalable Systems - Contribute to the design and maintenance of secure, robust, and high-performance infrastructure for our global gaming platforms.
⚙️ Drive Automation - Help implement and refine CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or CircleCI.
 Manage the Cloud - Assist in maintaining cloud environments (AWS or Azure) to ensure efficiency and scalability.
 Leverage Containers - Optimize and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - Collaborate on infrastructure provisioning and configuration with tools like Terraform and Ansible.

 Work with Data Streams - Help optimize real-time data flows and messaging systems with Kafka.
 Collaborate Across Teams - Work closely with software teams to promote a DevOps-first culture.


What You'll Bring
We're looking for an enthusiastic and driven individual with:
 Experience: 2+ years in a DevOps or related role.
☁️ Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure.
 Scripting Skills: Proficiency in scripting/programming languages like Python, Bash, or Go.
 Containerization: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
⚡ IaC Basics: Experience with tools like Terraform and Ansible.
 CI/CD Enthusiasm: Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bamboo.
️ Monitoring Skills: Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus and Grafana.
 Communication: Strong collaboration and communication skills in both Greek and English.
